Thus reduced support is 2 alternating planes, 9 mixed-parity coordinate lines, 9 noncoordinate lines, all irredundant. Holomorphic Morse–Bott lemma gives 3- or 4-square transverse node and generically reduced Jacobian scheme; nothing claimed at intersections.
